name: Hypefury
summary: Scheduling and growth tools for X, LinkedIn and Threads.
description: Hypefury schedules threads and posts, automatically recycles top performers and automates some growth actions. AI tools help with ideas and rephrasing.
summary_fr: Planification et croissance sur X, LinkedIn et Threads.
description_fr: Hypefury planifie threads et posts, recycle automatiquement les publications qui ont le mieux marché et automatise certaines actions de croissance. Des outils IA aident à trouver des idées et à reformuler les contenus.

pricing.label: Premium
pricing.note: Paid plans; see the official site for current pricing.

features: Thread and post scheduling with smart queues.
Auto-retweet and repost rules for evergreen content.
Analytics on reach and best-performing posts.
